a2t_calibration_identity_hash_convention: a2t_calibration_split_identity_hash is SHA-256 over the LF-joined sorted roster 'key' values (audio2tool:<tier>:<id6>) -- the Audio2Tool probe-receipt integrity convention. a2t_calibration_flight_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)) over audio2tool/<tier>:<id6>, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time and the value the frozen roster docs/receipts/rosters/a2t-evo-curve-400-v1.json carries as its own split_identity_hash. Both cover the same 400 rows.
a2t_calibration_key_names: The a2t_calibration_* key names are the flight-family contract scripts/flights/run_calibration_cell.py and scripts/a2t_calibration_prompt_fit.py read; reusing them is what lets this roster fly through the SAME entry point and the SAME FlightRuntime as every other Audio2Tool direct cell, with no new code path. The keys name a receipt-scoped roster, not the calibration split.
a2t_calibration_population: The EVO-A1 CURVE roster: a 400-row tier-stratified subset (50 per tier over all eight tiers) of the sealed A2T-ORG1-UNION-4000, drawn ONCE by core.roster.freeze_roster at seed 20260906 with split_role 'discovery' and roster_role 'evaluation'. Builder scripts/build_a2t_evo_curve_roster.py; exposure row SAEA-SN-MF-A2T-EVO-CURVE-ROSTER-V1. Option A of the preregistration's section 7, closed by the coordinator on 2026-09-06: a strict SUBSET of the final read's population, so the curve and the evaluation delta are measured on one distribution and the generalization gap is not confounded by a population change.
a2t_calibration_role: READ ONCE PER ROUND by that round's post-decision incumbent, under run id SAEA-A2T-EVO-A1-CURVE-400-V1, attempt attempt-r{r}-curve. IT DECIDES NOTHING: no stage-one gate, no confirmation, no acceptance and no kill rule reads it. It exists so the loop has a curve measured on the population the final read uses.
a2t_calibration_pairing: Every one of these 400 rows already carries a SEALED official-protocol output under the compact registry, produced by SAEA-A2T-TIER1-OFFICIAL-POPULATION-V1 (attempt-20260904T172609Z-t1officialpop500), SAEA-A2T-TIER258-OFFICIAL-POPULATION-V1 (attempt-20260904T193726Z-t258officialpop1500) and SAEA-A2T-TIER3467-OFFICIAL-POPULATION-V1 (attempt-20260904T211040Z-t3467officialpop2000). Nothing is re-flown on the baseline side: greedy decoding is not bitwise reproducible across batch shapes on this runtime.
a2t_calibration_strata: tier (50 per tier, all eight) and domain (smart_home 281, wearables 82, smart_car 37). Domain is recorded as counts in the roster receipt and resolved per sample at ANALYSIS time from each tier's released manifest, never at request time. 363 distinct query_idx blocks.
a2t_calibration_d1_media_supplement: NO NEW SUPPLEMENT. All 400 sample ids are already inside the D1 identity closure: 392 through the additive docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-a2t-org1-union-4000.json and the other 8 through the immutable docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-identity.json, which contracts.gate_media_identity verifies against and skips. The gate accepts exactly one supplement path per run and verifies only the samples the binding names, so this fragment configures the union's own supplement; a 392-row subset copy would re-bind identities the union supplement already binds and close no gate it does not already close.
a2t_calibration_scoring_identity: NO NEW PROBE-SAMPLE RECEIPT. All 400 sample ids already resolve inside data.audio2tool's frozen-receipt universe: 196 through a2t-tier3467-official-population-2000.json, 143 through a2t-tier258-official-population-1500.json, 49 through a2t-tier1-official-population-500.json, 8 through r1-audio2tool-sample.json and 4 through select-fill-agentloop-104-postseal-scoring.json. A receipt repeating any of them would be refused by _resolve_items as a duplicate and would break the loader outright.
a2t_calibration_exposure: Already-consumed discovery identities: every one of these 400 rows was contacted on 2026-09-04 under the official protocol and again on 2026-09-05 under ORG-1. Adding the roster receipt leaves the 5,279-identity Audio2Tool exposure union unchanged (15 sources instead of 14). This fragment grants no contact authority; docs/readiness/2026-09-06-a2t-evo-a1-description-evolution-v1-preregistration.md and the exposure ledger do.
a2t_calibration_no_driver_split_name: This fragment deliberately declares no split_name key. split_id names the receipt-scoped split the calibration adapter resolves from the hash-pinned roster receipt above; it is never resolved through the generic probe-receipt universe.
a2t_calibration_longest_row_note: The draw inherited TWO of the union's four 654-second synthesis defects -- tier6_correction:003151 and tier7_multiturn:001033, both 654.635667 s -- and they are KEPT, because the sealed baseline outputs this read is paired against were produced on exactly these rows and because dodging them would make the draw a selection rather than a subset. Two consequences the budget and the geometry must carry: one curve pass costs 3,470.346292 s rather than the 2,342 s the preregistration estimated by scaling the union's mean, and under the mmproj encoder's one-second window rule n_tokens = 13 * ceil(audio_seconds) the worst row costs 8,515 speech tokens, so the curve cell's serving geometry is the union's rather than the folds' looser one. The prompt fit re-derives both.
